products.documentedFactsAndLimits: S1 Current Conditions/Data Sources describes model data and Météo-France SST (0.08°, six-hourly, daily updates). S2 separates initialization/conversion/API availability. Neither binds an existing capture to a deployed run or proves effective feature resolution.
products.currentEvidenceRecommendation: R1: retain instant model-valid-state semantics, actual layout and missing provenance. Operational thermal/habitat use requires the chosen provenance standard and source/consumer validation; do not label model output as satellite observation.
products.historicalRecommendation: Exact run/revision preferred when obtainable; stable-family/value-valid-time admission requires explicit justified approval. Valid time is not possession. Missing model facts cannot be reconstructed from capture values.

products.documentedFactsAndLimits: S3 identifies altimetry-derived geostrophic u/v, m/s, 0.25° grid, MDT CNES/CLS 2013. `time_bnds` is named but per-record bounds/mapping window are not supplied by the info page. This is not RTOFS or total surface current.
products.currentEvidenceRecommendation: R2: preserve V3 capture and accepted-chain authority; require exact neighborhood correspondence and product-specific scale/uncertainty validation for current/edge/shear uses. Capture integrity is not scientific qualification.
products.historicalRecommendation: Require actual support, mapping/version/revision authority and exact-vintage cutoff possession. Daily map timestamps do not establish independence. Convergence/Ocean Physics remain quarantined.

products.documentedFactsAndLimits: S4 names S-NPP VIIRS mapped NRT daily L3, nominal 4km; `baseline_bounds` referenced without values. Prior report records title/processing-level ambiguity. Nominal noon time does not settle composite/pixel support.
products.currentEvidenceRecommendation: R3: preserve DIRECT, selection, quality and valid no-pixel versus absent record; qualify this exact product before operational productivity/clarity. NRT is not automatically delayed science-quality.
products.historicalRecommendation: Obtain authoritative UTC/aggregation bounds and processing/vintage availability. Neither midnight-to-midnight nor noon±12h is justified. Retain unadmitted until resolved.

products.documentedFactsAndLimits: S5 describes experimental DINEOF reconstruction. S6 identifies merged daily inputs plus monthly climatology and Level 4, versus endpoint Level 3. S7's 2019 operational account uses target day plus prior 29 daily images; current exact deployment is unproven.
products.currentEvidenceRecommendation: R4: preserve reconstruction separately from DIRECT and all actual/unknown lineage. Smooth maps do not establish observed sample coverage or local uncertainty. Shared source pixels cannot independently corroborate DIRECT.
products.historicalRecommendation: Require target bounds, deployed window/version, contributor/climatology vintage and revision/delayed-input treatment. Do not pool DIRECT/GAP or count reconstruction days as independent observations.
